description_excerpt: Job Title Partner Account Manager Job Description Partner Account Manager Job Family Summary: This role is an Individual Contributor, will be based in Ho Chi Minh City, and will report directly to Sales Leader. You are responsible for: • Defining and effectively executing the Philips-Partner Strategy to sustainably grow the business. • As a main point of Partner contact, the creation and execution of a joint business plan and capability development of Partner to drive and achieve set (yearly) targets. • Understands the optimized Go to Market set-up in the assigned territory and will drive it…
